Ten moments from first run to failure, each drawn as today (left) and proposed (right) for the toolbar pill, the Settings row, the size alert and the run-deferral message. Evidence and sources: docs/private/app-store-launch/ba-ux-research.md.

Transcribed with Apple’s speech model
CommentaryToday: nothing says which engine ran. Settings says Whisper, the run uses Apple’s until the model is on disk. Proposed (INVENTED, option for the owner): a per-session line, “Transcribed with Apple’s speech model” / “…with Whisper”, in the session’s detail only, so a reader can tell which engine produced which transcript. Not on the Sessions grid, not in the pill: one place, shown after the fact. Needs the engine recorded per session; check whether the manifest already carries it before costing it. New strings: 2 (one per engine) × 21 locales.

2Offering Whisper: the size alert4.2.3(ii) disclosureproposed text = option

today · main + ba-whisper-build · NSAlert sheet, asked once per Mac
B
Download the Whisper speech model?
About 1.6 GB. It helps with poor audio and people talking over each other. You can download it later in Settings.
DownloadNot Now
proposed · macOS 26 and later only; one sentence swapped in
B
Download the Whisper speech model?
About 1.5 GB. Apple’s speech model transcribes until Whisper is on this Mac. You can download it later in Settings.
DownloadNot Now
CommentaryWhat the guideline needs: 4.2.3(ii) asks that the app disclose the size and prompt before downloading; today’s alert does (size, two buttons, Escape answers Not Now). Gap this closes: a researcher who says Not Now, or ignores the pill, still has Whisper selected in Settings and a run silently on Apple’s engine. The dashed sentence (INVENTED, 1 string × 21 locales) replaces the benefit clause, so the alert stays at three sentences. It is true only where Apple’s engine exists: on macOS 15 the alert keeps today’s text. Buttons are drawn as a row with the default trailing, as an NSAlert lays them out (the first mock stacked them). Why no alert at a relaunch (read from code, not reproduced): autoStart returns .ask only while hasAnswered is false; the answer is stored in UserDefaults, so after one Download or Not Now it never asks again (by design), and after Download the next launch starts silently. A first run with no alert has another cause (no AI consent yet, under 10 GB free, a remembered Stop): unknown on build 6532. Review risk, from the App Store review: after Not Now, with under 10 GB free, on macOS 15 or with a pinned language, a run that needs Whisper still fetches from Hugging Face with no alert (design doc §7 exception). A reviewer who says Not Now and then watches a download start is a 4.2.3(ii) rejection. Not drawn here because it is a behaviour, not a pixel.

Starting
For your next recordings. Whisper copes better with poor audio, people talking over each other and larger groups.
CommentaryMeasured today (Foundation on macOS 27): ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: 0, countStyle: .file) returns “Zero KB”, and a Progress with 0 completed units and 1.6 GB total prints “Zero KB of 1.61 GB”. That is the line shown while the bar is at 0, which is the wait before Background Assets reports its first byte. Fix, no new string: treat 0 bytes as not started, show a moving indeterminate bar (HIG: “Keep progress indicators moving”; the bar stops under Reduce Motion) and the shipped desktop.cloudImport.downloadStarting (“Starting”, shipped for the importer). Setting allowsNonnumericFormatting = false would give “0 KB”: honest, still ugly.

CommentaryWhat the API gives: a Progress (completed and total units, cancellable) and nothing else; throughput and time remaining are not set by Apple (observed 17 Nov). Deliberately not proposed: an ETA. The BA download took about 2.5 minutes on 17 Nov, an estimate would be short-lived and would invent a new string (Foundation’s localised line needs a rate Apple does not supply); the HIG warns that progress which jumps “can even feel deceptive”. Only change: one rule for sizes (“1.5 GB” in the alert, 1.61 GB in the line, 1.6 GB on disk are three spellings of one model); fix the formatter, do not merge the true numbers (about 1.5 GB download, 1.6 GB on disk). The percent beside the bar duplicates the popover; left as shipped. Stop note: the branch already hides “Starts again from the beginning next time.” on the Background Assets path, so both frames omit it. Cancel restarting from byte 0 is observed, not documented, so copy says neither. No confirmation: a restart costs about 2.5 minutes, not a real loss.

p4.mp4
Waiting for Whisper
Apple’s speech model wasn’t sure of what it heard, so Whisper will transcribe it once it’s on this Mac.
CommentaryDrawn identically on purpose. An earlier draft repeated the pill’s percentage inside the deferral line; the Mac review called that a fourth progress readout in one window (the pill, the popover and the Settings row already show it) and the HIG asks for progress in one consistent place. Dropped. The gap here is not the wait, it is the end of the wait: the design doc (open item 4) says that with Whisper absent and Background Assets failing, a deferred session waits indefinitely, and the App Store review rates that as the most likely thing a reviewer meets, because reviewer fetches of Apple-hosted packs have failed in several forum reports. The wait needs an end state (the failed pill and Retry, or letting Apple’s transcript stand). That is a behaviour decision for the owner, not a pixel.

CommentaryThe row and the pill already read one WhisperDownloadModel so they cannot disagree; the proposal only changes the byte line to the pill’s. Ready: “On this Mac · 1.6 GB” (shipped) and the status row hides under the Apple choice. Failed: the shipped cause lines (disk, network, certificate) plus Retry. The size reads 1.6 GB on disk and “about 1.5 GB” in the alert and 1.61 GB in the progress line: three spellings of one number (1,613,977,612 B plus config, pack download size 1,501,833,765 B); pick one unit rule.

proposed · titled with the cause; Retry stays
Ikea interviewsWhisper didn’t download
Connection dropped
The connection dropped and didn’t come back.
Retry
CommentaryOffline: macOS owns a Background Assets download; the observed failure on a dropped server was NSURLErrorDomain -1005 and the OS did not retry by itself, so Retry is right. Proposed: drop the “Whisper copes better…” pitch from inside an error (a sales sentence does not belong in a failure), and title the popover with the cause (owner, 18 Nov: “Connection dropped”); the pill keeps “Whisper didn’t download”. The title repeats the body’s first words, so the body could shrink to the instruction once the cause has a title; owner to say. Low disk: the shipped cause line is “This Mac doesn’t have enough free space for it.” An earlier draft added “about 1.6 GB free”; dropped, because nobody has measured that 1.6 GB is enough for download plus staging, and a wrong number is worse than none. A lone Retry on a full disk is a dead end: the better fix is to name the fact to act on once it is measured (house rule). The app also does not auto-start below 10 GB free (owner, 30 Oct) and says nothing about that: gap G8. Owner decision, 18 Nov: a dropped connection keeps Retry (a retry can work). Low disk (moment 10) gets “Transcription Settings…” instead, because a retry cannot work there and Settings is where the researcher sees the other models and Download Now. One button per popover. How other doors open Settings on this tab is not yet found; owed before build. Raw detail: the house rule is interpretation first, raw behind a disclosure; the shipped popover has none (gap G10, not an invention).

CommentarySame pill, same row. Here the app owns the download, so rate, time left and the “starts again” note are true and shown. The line “(10.0 MB/s) — About 1 minute, 23 seconds remaining” is Foundation’s own text, em dash included; the no-em-dash rule is about our copy, so the owner decides whether to accept a system string or compose the line. On macOS 15 there is no Apple engine, so a first run waits for Whisper; a different state that this page does not redraw. Locale cost of everything marked INVENTED: 1 string × 21 locales (the “meanwhile” sentence); the per-session engine line is not drawn.

Ikea interviewsNot enough space for Whisper
Not enough free space
Bristlenose recommends 10 GB free space. The Whisper speech model needs 1.6 GB.

CommentaryToday: with under 10 GB free the app does not offer the download and says nothing (gap G8); a session that needs Whisper shows “Waiting for Whisper” with no pill and nothing saying why, and waits for ever (the runMustDefer defect). Proposed (INVENTED, R114 gate): a new state of the existing pill, amber because nothing failed, the app simply did not start. Body is owner-written (18 Nov): “Bristlenose recommends 10 GB free space. The Whisper speech model needs 1.6 GB.” (10 GB is the app’s own auto-start floor; 1.6 GB the model’s size). New strings: the pill label, the popover title and the body, × 21 locales; the two sizes should be interpolated, not baked in. The one button opens Settings (moment 7: other models, Download Now), where Download Now is not held by the 10 GB floor. No promise that it will offer again. Scope: only a session that needs Whisper waits; runs that already have transcripts are unaffected and show no pill. Bug 2 (open): a run that starts while the size question is open: should the question manage itself, or is letting Download start with a run live (9b7dd24c7) enough? Owner to say.
